subject: th-cont
title: (R)TH.CONT.------T.C.IMP.------COS.AGN.
description: Chart on book p. 61 (BK(NM)-37). TH-CONT (thrust continuance) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and COS-AGN (cosmic assignment) are the partners in the title. From the subject: C-INFO (composite information). From T-C-IMP: COS-AGN. From COS-AGN: MTA-IMP (meta-implications) and INFO-AF-B-2 (information affinity basis). From C-INFO: CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics). From INFO-AF-B-2: AFI (affinity insight). From CULT-INFO-DY: INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis). From AFI: BIA (bi-aitional). From BIA: DYM-F (dynamic functionalism).
